snippet.title: OpenHunter announcement
snippet.description:
planned december / jan release, this is a full rewrite of metroid prime hunters for windows, linux (and if someones willing to compile it) mac. 
This will not have any proprietary assets included, you will need to supply your own metroid prime hunters and metroid prime hunters first hunt rom files in order to play. 
There is still much work being done on the project as we speak so no footage is 100% final, but its starting to get close enough to say that its gonna be done at some point.
Ranked is planned and so are hunter licenses.
